trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiate outbound call and ask for customer.
steps.text: नमस्ते, क्या मेरी बात उनसे हो रही है जिन्होंने हाल ही में एक gaming console का order place किया था?
हाँ, मैं बोल रहा हूँ। क्या हुआ? मेरा बेटा next Wednesday अपने birthday के लिए wait कर रहा है।
नमस्ते। मैं marketplace से call कर रहा हूँ। क्या आप मुझे अपना order ID बता सकते हैं ताकि मैं details check कर सकूँ?

steps.purpose: Provide order ID and ask clarifying question.
steps.text: एक मिनट, मैं check करता हूँ। हाँ, मेरा order ID ORD-30010 है। सब ठीक तो है ना?
Thank you. आगे बढ़ने से पहले, क्या आप अपना नाम और registered pincode confirm कर सकते हैं?
मेरा नाम राहुल है और pincode 400001 है। Order कब आएगा?
Thank you राहुल जी। Verification successful रहा। मुझे आपको यह बताने के लिए call करना पड़ा कि seller आपका gaming console fulfill नहीं कर पा रहे हैं। इसलिए हमें यह order cancel करना पड़ रहा है।
Cancel? पर मैंने तो 45999 rupees prepaid pay किये हैं! मेरा पैसा कब वापस मिलेगा?
जी, मैं confirm कर सकता हूँ कि आपका 45,999 rupees का prepaid payment safe है। Order अभी packed status में था। Cancellation process होने के बाद refund initiate हो जाएगा।
क्या मुझे refund की जगह कोई replacement या same console किसी और seller से मिल सकता है?

steps.purpose: Clarify that replacements are not offered.
steps.text: माफ़ी चाहूँगा राहुल जी, पर outbound cancellation में हम replacement offer नहीं कर सकते। आपको refund मिलने के बाद नया order place करना होगा।

steps.purpose: Ask about refund timeline with relative day.
steps.text: तो refund मेरे account में कब तक आएगा? मुझे परसो नया order करना पड़ेगा। क्या परसो तक पैसे आ जाएंगे?

steps.purpose: Resolve relative day and decline guarantee.
steps.text: मैं परसो, यानी Friday तक refund आने की guarantee नहीं दे सकता क्योंकि cancellation के बाद refund process होने में bank का standard time लगता है। मैं अभी सिर्फ cancellation confirm कर सकता हूँ।
ठीक है। क्या मैं इस seller के खिलाफ complaint raise कर सकता हूँ? उन्होंने मेरा time waste किया।
मैं अभी complaint raise नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि आपके order को सिर्फ 3 दिन हुए हैं और promised delivery window 6 दिन की थी। Policy के हिसाब से window खत्म होने से पहले complaint raise नहीं हो सकती।

steps.purpose: Express anxiety and ask for reassurance.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो मुझे अभी कुछ और नहीं करना पड़ेगा ना? मैं थोड़ा worried हूँ क्योंकि यह मेरा पहला बड़ा purchase था, और मैं नहीं चाहता कि मेरे पैसे फँस जाएँ।
आपको चिंता करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। आपको अपनी तरफ से कुछ नहीं करना है। आपका 45,999 rupees का refund उसी account में आएगा जिससे आपने payment किया था।

steps.purpose: Agree to check statement next week.
steps.text: ठीक है। तो मैं अगले हफ्ते Tuesday को statement check करूँगा। अगर नहीं आया तो फिर call करूँगा।
जी बिल्कुल, आप अगले हफ्ते Tuesday को अपना statement check कर लीजिए। अगर refund reflect ना हो तो आप हमें दोबारा contact कर सकते हैं।

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

issues.detail: The agent mentions the item 'gaming console' in e1 and informs the user about order cancellation in e9 before calling lookup_order. When lookup_order is finally called, the status is 'packed', contradicting the cancellation claim.
issues.repair_instruction: Since this is an outbound call, the agent should call lookup_order with the known order ID at the very beginning of the interaction. The tool should return status 'cancelled' to justify the agent's cancellation notice. The agent must not state any order details before the tool returns them.

issues.detail: The persona requires the user to 'Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.' However, the user volunteers the figure '45999' in e10 before the agent mentions it, which is not restating.
issues.repair_instruction: Have the agent state the refund amount first based on the tool output, and then have the anxious user restate the exact figure back to the agent to confirm they heard it correctly.

verification.summary: The dialogue fails primarily due to severe tool grounding violations. The agent hallucinates order details and cancellation status before making any tool calls. Additionally, the user persona trait of restating figures is not properly demonstrated, as the user volunteers the amount before the agent states it. A full regeneration is required to fix the logical flow, starting with a tool call to retrieve the order details before speaking.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks if the refund will arrive by a relative day ('अगले सोमवार' / next Monday), and the agent successfully resolves this to a concrete date ('23 October') while addressing the query.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds the refund amount, payment mode, and tracking status on the tool outputs, and correctly refuses to guarantee a refund date not present in the system. issues.detail: The agent claims the order was cancelled by the seller (e9) because they could not fulfill it (e11). When the user asks why, the agent should clarify that the system does not specify the exact reason, but immediately pivot to reassuring them about the full refund.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the persona and the relative day resolution variant. However, it fails the strict Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent hallucinates that the seller cancelled the order due to fulfillment issues, which was not present in the tool's output.
